findings.message: This is an instance fix of round 4's unchanged-push finding. Marks for unchanged proposals now move only when a push is sent with `dryRun: false`. The plugin, which is the only real caller of sync_specclaw, never sends that call when a push has nothing new. Step 3 stops at 'amax is up to date' whenever the preview shows created=0, updated=0 and needsReview=false, and a preview is always rolled back, so no mark moves. The new test hides the gap because it calls `push({dryRun:false})` directly and skips the skill's flow. The README line 'every specclaw writer moves that mark for each proposal it read' is false for plugin pushes. Fix: either have the skill apply (`dryRun:false`) a no-op push too, so its marks commit, or have the dry-run path commit the mark step, for example a separate `markSynced` call for the unchanged keys after the preview. Then add a variant test that drives preview-then-stop as the skill does.
findings.scenario: FLT-102 was pushed from main at 09:00 with content X. A developer runs the plugin on main at 10:00, still with content X. The preview shows 0/0, the skill says 'amax is up to date' and stops, and the mark stays at 09:00. Another developer then pushes a main commit from 09:30 with content Y (edited, then reverted). 09:00 < 09:30 passes the stale gate, and Y overwrites the newer X.

findings.message: The self-sync moves the mark for changed rows and unchanged rows, but its third write path doesn't move it. The withdraw loop (lines 78-81) calls `syncProposal` without `committedAt`, so a proposal the self-sync withdraws keeps its old mark. This also isn't fail-closed: `committedAt` is still optional on `syncSpecclaw` (line 44) and on the `syncProposal` service input (services.ts:207), and when it's missing every mark update is silently skipped. Only the MCP tool's schema was tightened, so the service and importer still let a specclaw write leave no mark. Fix: pass `opts.committedAt` on the withdraw write, and make `committedAt` required on `syncSpecclaw`. Also require it in `SyncInput` whenever `source` is 'specclaw', or refuse such writes without it. Add a withdraw-then-older-push row to the AC-8 variant test.
findings.scenario: FLT-103 was last pushed at 09:00. A self-sync from a 12:30 main commit finds folder 103 deleted and marks FLT-103 withdrawn, but its mark stays at 09:00. Then sync_specclaw runs from an 11:00 main commit that still has folder 103. The proposal isn't stale (09:00 < 11:00) and its fingerprint differs (the withdrawn flag is missing), so the upsert rewrites meta and un-withdraws a proposal the newer commit deleted.

findings.message: When a repo is relinked without `defaultBranch`, the stored `repo_default_ref` is kept even if the relink points to a different repo. The new repo then gets the old repo's default branch, which decides which pushes may update every change. Fix: keep the stored branch only when `normaliseRepo(input.repoUrl)` equals the stored `repo_url`. Otherwise require `defaultBranch`, the same way a first link does. Add the repo-change relink as a test row.
findings.scenario: FLT is linked to example/fleet-tracker with defaultBranch 'trunk'. A PM relinks FLT to example/fleet-v2, whose default branch is main, and gives no branch, so 'trunk' is kept. Pushes from fleet-v2's main now count as a branch and their changes get skipped. Anyone who pushes a branch named 'trunk' in fleet-v2 can overwrite every proposal as if it were the default branch.

findings.message: A needsReview push that created and updated nothing returns `outcome: "unchanged"`, but it writes a `delivery.sync_push` row with `outcome = 'applied'` (line 131). The caller and the Repo sync card therefore disagree. plugins/amax/README.md:55 and SKILL.md:47 say an `unchanged` push adds no row, which is wrong in this case. Fix: return a distinct outcome, or 'applied', whenever a row is written, so the result matches the stored row, and correct the plugin docs.
findings.scenario: A default-branch push whose only record has an unreadable state.json returns outcome 'unchanged' and needsReview true. The Repo sync card shows an 'applied' row for the same push.

findings.message: The narrowed `hasCredentials` refuses a user-only userinfo only for `http(s)://`, but `normaliseRepo` accepts any `[a-z+]+://` scheme. A token in the user position of `git+https://` or `git+http://` used to be refused and is now silently accepted. It is stripped before storage, so nothing leaks, but the comment's claim of 'any user in an http(s) URL' misses these variants. Fix: match `^(git\+)?https?://` or any scheme with `+http` in it.
findings.scenario: link_project_repo with repoUrl 'git+https://ghp_SECRET@github.com/example/portal' is accepted. Before this diff it was refused.

findings.message: The link-repo intent's `required` list still leaves out `defaultBranch`, but a first link now refuses to run without it. Chat can therefore build and confirm a card that is bound to fail. Fix: add `defaultBranch` to `required`, or make the confirm card ask for it when the project has no stored branch.
findings.scenario: 'Link FLT to https://github.com/example/fleet' with no branch → the confirm card is shown, the person confirms, and the service throws 'name FLT's default branch'.

findings.message: `markSynced` caps `keys` at 500, and it runs only after all of the self-sync's per-row writes have committed. If a repo has more than 500 unchanged changes, the run fails validation partway through: changed rows are written, but no marks move and no withdrawals happen. Fix: send the keys in batches, or drop the cap so it matches the importer's unbounded input.
findings.scenario: A self-sync finds 600 unchanged changes and 1 changed → the changed row commits, then markSynced throws, and the withdraw loop never runs.

findings.message: A no-op apply writes its audit with `resource: "delivery.sync_push"` but `resourceId` set to the project's id, so the audit row points to a sync_push that doesn't exist. Fix: put the project id in the audit `after` field, or audit the no-op with resource `delivery.project`, as `markSynced` does.
findings.scenario: An unchanged push is audited as delivery.sync_push/<FLT project uuid>. Looking that id up in delivery.sync_push finds nothing.
